purpose: Astella Shape of Dreams-inspired composition comparison
scope: Preview only. Keep the existing centered composition. No live Unity scene, prefab, profile or runtime changes.
inputImages: The user's second screenshot informed composition and environmental depth. No image was used as an edit target; no third-party screenshot, logo or UI was copied into this package.
prompt:
Create an original fantasy video game title-screen ENVIRONMENT BACKDROP for ASTELLA, without any text or UI.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape 16:9 cinematic composition. A high quality immersive stylized 3D fantasy environment with painterly surfaces, atmospheric depth, beautiful volumetric lighting, as if a still from an art-directed indie fantasy RPG main menu.

Scene: an ancient moonlit crystal woodland sanctuary. On the RIGHT, a monumental dark silver-barked tree grows around a tall faceted amethyst heartstone, its sweeping trunk and sculptural branches forming an asymmetric canopy. A pale silver and lilac dawn radiates from this crystal heart, catching bark edges and drifting translucent petals. Brilliant icy lavender flowers and delicate crystalline ferns fill the near foreground along the bottom and right, with a few dark close branches framing the view. Through the CENTER, a winding ancient stone footpath descends into a luminous blue-violet clearing, layered mist, and distant broken silver stone arches. Show inviting depth and a believable explorable environment, not a flat wallpaper of crystals. Central distant sky opening is cool blue, the right focal light is pearl-silver with a trace of warm dawn gold. Color identity: deep ink-blue shadows, rich amethyst violet, silver-white light, soft lavender, restrained amber accents.

CRITICAL COMPOSITION: Keep the LEFTMOST 34 percent visually calm, dark blue-violet and low contrast, with only sparse distant silhouettes and mist. The upper left quarter will hold a large ivory serif ASTELLA wordmark; below it a vertical menu from 40 to 84 percent screen height. Do not draw those elements. Put the brightest light and detailed tree/flower masses on the right half. Scene fills the whole canvas, no panel or border. It should have the theatrical foreground framing and magical garden scale of a beautiful fantasy main-menu scene, while remaining an original Astella environment.

Avoid: all letters, words, typography, symbols that look like writing, menus, HUD, buttons, title logos, watermark, third-party branding, credits, human figures, close characters, UI boxes, excessive neon bloom, photorealism, pixel art, symmetric centered composition. This is only the original illustrated backdrop; actual text will be rendered separately.
